stages.title: GOVERNANCE LAYER MAP

COMMON SPORT RULES AND INTERNATIONAL RECOGNITION

stages.title: SIX-TEST CHECKLIST FOR A SPORTS BODY

pills.text: SIX-TEST CHECKLIST FOR A SPORTS BODY
STATUTE, RECOGNITION, CONTRACT OR A PRIVATE RULE BOOK
PUBLISHED CRITERIA, AND WITHDRAWAL WITH RECORDED REASONS
ELECTIONS, TENURE LIMITS, ATHLETE AND GENDER REPRESENTATION
